hero.title: V6
hero.tagline: A JavaScript runtime built on the JVM. V6 compiles JavaScript directly to JVM bytecode and runs it with a persistent warm process, so repeated runs start fast, and it can call into any Java library already on the classpath through a built-in java: import scheme.
